claim_summary: At fixed squared two-harmonic diffusivity energy, Fourier–Galerkin second-order generator leakage is uniquely maximized by the pure second harmonic at cutoffs 2 and 3 and by an explicit nontrivial mixture from cutoff 4 onward, with sharp limiting mixture gain 4/3; arbitrary spatial phases do not change the answer.

integrity.claim_status: Same-model correctness/originality/value review only; no independent audit
integrity.computational_checks: Standard-library exact-rational and floating-point checks described in VERIFICATION.md

scientific_limitations: Exact periodic Fourier–Galerkin projection of a strictly elliptic two-harmonic scalar diffusion only
The comparison fixes the sum of squares of the harmonic amplitudes, not pointwise extrema of diffusivity
No inference to finite-sample data, global finite-time accuracy or general diffusivity families
title: Sharp cutoff-four onset and sharp \(4/3\) amplification of Fourier–Galerkin leakage in two-harmonic diffusion
